title: 雙曲拱壩拱座分析~Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams
focus: 拱推力、岸坡楔體與壩岩相容的三維判讀~Three-dimensional interpretation of arch thrust, abutment wedges and dam-rock compatibility
summary: 本課以雙曲拱壩拱座分析為入口，深入拱推力、岸坡楔體與壩岩相容的三維判讀。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams as its entry point, this course examines three-dimensional interpretation of arch thrust, abutment wedges and dam-rock compatibility. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 薄拱公式的局部敏感度固定均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa和半徑80 m，只將厚度由8增加至10 m。理想壓應力σ=pR/t由5降至4 MPa，減少20%。比較保持無彎曲的連續圓拱假設；真實加厚會改變三維剛度、溫度與拱梁分載，不能把此倒數關係視為完整拱壩設計結論。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For local sensitivity of the thin-arch relation, hold uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa and radius 80 m fixed, increasing only thickness from 8 m to 10 m. Ideal compression σ=pR/t falls from 5 to 4 MPa, a 20% reduction. The comparison retains a continuous circular arch without bending; actual thickening changes three-dimensional stiffness, temperature and arch-cantilever sharing, so the inverse relation is not a complete dam-design conclusion.
history: 雙曲拱壩把壩體與兩岸岩體當作共同承載系統，拱座調查和三維變形相容比單看混凝土壓應力更能揭露控制條件。墾務局修訂拱壩與重力壩設計準則，提供兩種傳力方式比較。 工兵團拱壩設計手冊出版，整理設計、分析與施工背景。 重力壩手冊出版，作岩基及穩定概念的對照。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。~A double-curvature arch dam and its abutment rock act as one load-bearing system. Abutment investigation and three-dimensional compatibility reveal controls beyond concrete compression alone. Reclamation revises arch and gravity design criteria, comparing distinct load-transfer systems. USACE publishes Arch Dam Design, covering design, analysis and construction context. Gravity Dam Design is published as a comparison for foundation and stability concepts. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

units.anchor: 薄拱膜力初估~Thin-arch membrane estimate
units.title: 薄拱膜力初估~Thin-arch membrane estimate
units.mechanism: 雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。真實壩體同時有懸臂彎曲、變厚與非圓形幾何，不能只用單一半徑設計。 假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。~A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature. Thin circular-arch membrane action gives an initial scale, while real dams also have cantilever bending, variable thickness and noncircular geometry. Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending. The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending.
units.verify: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。分開報告拱冠與拱座附近的彎曲應力。~Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions. Report bending stresses near the crown and abutments as separate quantities.
units.failure: 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。~The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending.
units.misconception: 薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。~Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam.
units.practice: 以薄拱膜力初估編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for thin-arch membrane estimate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions.

units.anchor: 拱與懸臂分擔~Arch and cantilever load sharing
units.title: 拱與懸臂分擔~Arch and cantilever load sharing
units.mechanism: 壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。分擔比例由剛度與邊界形成，不是可任意指定以降低應力的設計選項。 假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。~Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement. Relative stiffness and boundaries determine sharing; the proportions cannot be arbitrarily chosen to make stresses smaller. Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only. Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only.
units.verify: 核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。確認兩路徑分擔總和仍等於原始水壓荷載。~Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone. Verify that the sum of both load paths still equals applied water loading.
units.failure: 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。~Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution.
units.misconception: 拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。~Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
units.practice: 以拱與懸臂分擔編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for arch and cantilever load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone.

units.anchor: 岸坡推力方向~Abutment thrust direction
units.title: 岸坡推力方向~Abutment thrust direction
units.mechanism: 拱推力到達岸坡時需要分解到岩面法向與剪向，方向與大小同樣重要。大壓力若指向易滑節理組合，仍可能形成不利楔體受力。 假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。 角度定義混淆會交換法向與剪向分量，直接改變摩擦判讀。若把整個岸坡用單一平面代表，可能漏掉由兩組節理交線控制的三維運動方向。~Arch thrust must be resolved normal and tangential to abutment surfaces, making direction as important as magnitude. Large compression can still destabilize a wedge when directed unfavorably relative to joints. Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal. Normal component is 17.3205 MN and tangential component 10 MN, a planar illustration rather than a complete wedge force system. Confusing angle definitions swaps normal and tangential components and changes friction assessment. Representing the whole abutment by one plane can miss three-dimensional movement controlled by intersecting joint sets.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal. Normal component is 17.3205 MN and tangential component 10 MN, a planar illustration rather than a complete wedge force system.
units.verify: 把節理法向和推力向量放到同一座標系，核對角度是相對法向還是面本身；用測繪和模型反力交叉確認，並保留各高程推力方向變化。以向量點積獨立重算法向與剪向分量。~Put joint normals and thrust in a common coordinate system and verify whether angles reference normals or surfaces. Cross-check mapping and model reactions, retaining changes in thrust direction with elevation. Independently recompute normal and tangential components using vector projections.
units.failure: 角度定義混淆會交換法向與剪向分量，直接改變摩擦判讀。若把整個岸坡用單一平面代表，可能漏掉由兩組節理交線控制的三維運動方向。~Confusing angle definitions swaps normal and tangential components and changes friction assessment. Representing the whole abutment by one plane can miss three-dimensional movement controlled by intersecting joint sets.
units.misconception: 岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。~Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction.
units.practice: 以岸坡推力方向編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把節理法向和推力向量放到同一座標系，核對角度是相對法向還是面本身；用測繪和模型反力交叉確認，並保留各高程推力方向變化。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for abutment thrust direction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Put joint normals and thrust in a common coordinate system and verify whether angles reference normals or surfaces. Cross-check mapping and model reactions, retaining changes in thrust direction with elevation.

units.anchor: 楔體滑動抗力~Wedge sliding resistance
units.title: 楔體滑動抗力~Wedge sliding resistance
units.mechanism: 岸坡不穩定可能沿既有節理滑動，而非岩石材料壓碎。有效正向力、節理摩擦與水壓控制抗力，幾何可動性必須先於數值安全比判讀。 假設單滑面總正力30 MN、水壓合力8 MN、摩擦角35°、驅動剪力10 MN，無黏聚比值(30−8)tan35°/10=1.5405。 即使岩石單軸強度高，光滑充填節理仍可能具有低抗剪。若忽略節理水壓或錯將不連續面當完整岩體，會高估岸坡承載並錯估壩體反力邊界。~Abutments can fail by sliding on existing joints rather than crushing intact rock. Effective normal force, joint friction and water pressure govern resistance, after geometric freedom to move has been established. Assume single-plane normal force 30 MN, water resultant 8 MN, friction angle 35 degrees and driving shear 10 MN. Cohesionless resistance ratio is 1.5405. Strong intact rock can contain smooth filled joints with low shear resistance. Omitting joint pressure or treating discontinuities as intact material overstates abutment support and distorts the boundary reactions assigned to the dam.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單滑面總正力30 MN、水壓合力8 MN、摩擦角35°、驅動剪力10 MN，無黏聚比值(30−8)tan35°/10=1.5405。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume single-plane normal force 30 MN, water resultant 8 MN, friction angle 35 degrees and driving shear 10 MN. Cohesionless resistance ratio is 1.5405.
units.verify: 用節理測繪確認滑面連續性和出露，將孔壓位置與實際滑面對應；分開峰值與殘餘摩擦，檢查楔體位移及裂縫監測是否支持所假設運動模式。檢查潛在楔體是否真有可向外移動的自由面。~Map continuity and daylighting of the sliding surface and locate pore pressures relative to it. Separate peak and residual friction and check whether wedge movement and crack observations support the assumed mechanism. Check whether the potential wedge genuinely has an outward movement surface.
units.failure: 即使岩石單軸強度高，光滑充填節理仍可能具有低抗剪。若忽略節理水壓或錯將不連續面當完整岩體，會高估岸坡承載並錯估壩體反力邊界。~Strong intact rock can contain smooth filled joints with low shear resistance. Omitting joint pressure or treating discontinuities as intact material overstates abutment support and distorts the boundary reactions assigned to the dam.
units.misconception: 岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。~High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding.
units.practice: 以楔體滑動抗力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用節理測繪確認滑面連續性和出露，將孔壓位置與實際滑面對應；分開峰值與殘餘摩擦，檢查楔體位移及裂縫監測是否支持所假設運動模式。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for wedge sliding resistance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map continuity and daylighting of the sliding surface and locate pore pressures relative to it. Separate peak and residual friction and check whether wedge movement and crack observations support the assumed mechanism.

units.anchor: 裂隙水壓分布~Joint water-pressure distribution
units.title: 裂隙水壓分布~Joint water-pressure distribution
units.mechanism: 水沿岩體節理傳遞到岸坡內部，裂隙開度與排水會使壓力分布不同於外部庫水線性內插。水壓合力及作用點都會影響楔體穩定。 假設矩形節理面200 m²，壓力由上緣0線性增到底部0.4 MPa，水壓合力40 MN，作用點距低壓邊2/3長度；限線性分布。 出水量小可能因通道堵塞而水壓更高，不等於岸坡變乾。只用一個低壓測點代表整個滑面，會低估未排水區的合力和不利力矩。~Water transmits through abutment joints, with aperture and drainage producing pressure distributions different from a simple interpolation of reservoir level. Both resultant and location influence wedge stability. Assume joint area 200 m² with pressure rising linearly from zero to 0.4 MPa. Resultant is 40 MN at two-thirds length from the low-pressure edge, for a linear distribution. Low discharge can indicate blockage with higher pressure rather than drier rock. Extending one low-pressure point over the full slip plane understates force and adverse moment in undrained portions.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設矩形節理面200 m²，壓力由上緣0線性增到底部0.4 MPa，水壓合力40 MN，作用點距低壓邊2/3長度；限線性分布。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 200 m² with pressure rising linearly from zero to 0.4 MPa. Resultant is 40 MN at two-thirds length from the low-pressure edge, for a linear distribution.
units.verify: 沿裂隙不同高程安裝代表性孔壓量測，核對與庫位變化的幅值和遲滯；將出水量與水壓分別報告，並積分非線性實測曲線比較教學三角形。利用壓力積分求作用點以核對不利轉動力矩。~Measure representative pressures at several joint elevations and compare amplitude and lag with reservoir levels. Report discharge and pressure separately, integrating measured nonlinear profiles against the triangular teaching approximation. Locate the integrated pressure resultant to check its adverse rotational moment.
units.failure: 出水量小可能因通道堵塞而水壓更高，不等於岸坡變乾。只用一個低壓測點代表整個滑面，會低估未排水區的合力和不利力矩。~Low discharge can indicate blockage with higher pressure rather than drier rock. Extending one low-pressure point over the full slip plane understates force and adverse moment in undrained portions.
units.misconception: 裂隙出水很少就能證明整個岸坡節理水壓很低。~Small joint discharge proves low water pressure throughout all abutment discontinuities.
units.practice: 以裂隙水壓分布編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿裂隙不同高程安裝代表性孔壓量測，核對與庫位變化的幅值和遲滯；將出水量與水壓分別報告，並積分非線性實測曲線比較教學三角形。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for joint water-pressure distribution, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure representative pressures at several joint elevations and compare amplitude and lag with reservoir levels. Report discharge and pressure separately, integrating measured nonlinear profiles against the triangular teaching approximation.

units.anchor: 岩體柔度與拱座位移~Rock compliance and abutment movement
units.title: 岩體柔度與拱座位移~Rock compliance and abutment movement
units.mechanism: 岸坡會在推力下變形，拱座向外移動可能改變拱壩內力分配。岩體等效模數受節理和尺度影響，不能直接使用完整岩芯模數代替現地反應。 假設簡化壓縮區長20 m、面積400 m²、岩體E=10 GPa、推力40 MN，δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm；均質單軸類比，非岸坡真實三維解。 把基礎截斷面固定得太近會人工增硬，可能得到過小位移和錯誤應力。若只靠調整岩體模數配合壩頂量測，其他邊界錯誤可能被隱藏。~Abutments deform under thrust and outward movement changes arch force distribution. Jointing and scale affect rock-mass modulus, preventing direct substitution of intact-core modulus for field response. Assume compressed zone length 20 m, area 400 m², rock-mass E=10 GPa and force 40 MN. δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm, a uniform uniaxial analogy rather than a real three-dimensional solution. Fixing foundation boundaries too close artificially stiffens the model and produces small displacements with wrong stresses. Adjusting modulus solely to fit crest movement can hide errors in other boundary assumptions.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設簡化壓縮區長20 m、面積400 m²、岩體E=10 GPa、推力40 MN，δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm；均質單軸類比，非岸坡真實三維解。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume compressed zone length 20 m, area 400 m², rock-mass E=10 GPa and force 40 MN. δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm, a uniform uniaxial analogy rather than a real three-dimensional solution.
units.verify: 比較現地變形試驗、節理調查與監測位移，建立模數範圍而非單值；改變基礎模型邊界距離和剛度，檢查壩體內力及拱座反力是否穩定。將完整岩芯與岩體模數的來源分開標示。~Compare field deformation tests, joint mapping and monitored movements to establish a modulus range. Vary foundation boundary distance and stiffness and check stability of dam forces and abutment reactions. Identify intact-core and rock-mass modulus evidence as separate information sources.
units.failure: 把基礎截斷面固定得太近會人工增硬，可能得到過小位移和錯誤應力。若只靠調整岩體模數配合壩頂量測，其他邊界錯誤可能被隱藏。~Fixing foundation boundaries too close artificially stiffens the model and produces small displacements with wrong stresses. Adjusting modulus solely to fit crest movement can hide errors in other boundary assumptions.
units.misconception: 完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。~Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass.
units.practice: 以岩體柔度與拱座位移編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較現地變形試驗、節理調查與監測位移，建立模數範圍而非單值；改變基礎模型邊界距離和剛度，檢查壩體內力及拱座反力是否穩定。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rock compliance and abutment movement, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare field deformation tests, joint mapping and monitored movements to establish a modulus range. Vary foundation boundary distance and stiffness and check stability of dam forces and abutment reactions.

units.anchor: 封拱溫度與接縫閉合~Closure temperature and joint closure
units.title: 封拱溫度與接縫閉合~Closure temperature and joint closure
units.mechanism: 拱壩接縫灌漿後形成不同於分離懸臂的整體作用，封拱溫度決定後續升溫壓縮和降溫張開傾向。溫度是結構初始狀態的一部分。 假設有效拱長200 m、α=10⁻⁵/K、相對封拱溫度下降8 K，自由縮短16 mm；真實拘束會轉成接縫位移和應力，非直接開縫總量。 把所有壩段視為同時同溫度閉合會忽略施工分期，局部灌漿不完整也可能保留柔弱面。若模型沒有記錄封拱狀態，溫度應力的符號可能被錯判。~Joint grouting creates an integrated arch distinct from separate cantilevers. Closure temperature establishes later warming compression and cooling-opening tendencies, making temperature part of the structural initial state. Assume effective arch length 200 m, α=10⁻⁵/K and cooling eight kelvin below closure temperature. Free shortening is 16 mm; actual restraint converts it into movement and stress rather than this exact total opening. Assuming simultaneous equal-temperature closure misses construction staging, and incomplete grouting leaves compliant interfaces. Without the closure state, even the sign of inferred thermal stress can be misinterpreted.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效拱長200 m、α=10⁻⁵/K、相對封拱溫度下降8 K，自由縮短16 mm；真實拘束會轉成接縫位移和應力，非直接開縫總量。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective arch length 200 m, α=10⁻⁵/K and cooling eight kelvin below closure temperature. Free shortening is 16 mm; actual restraint converts it into movement and stress rather than this exact total opening.
units.verify: 核對灌漿時的多點溫度而非單一氣溫，將接縫計零點與施工日期連結；比較後續同庫位不同溫度的變形，確認模型初始狀態可重現觀測。對各灌漿區塊保留自己的封拱溫度紀錄。~Check multi-point grouting temperatures rather than ambient air alone and link joint-meter zeros to construction dates. Compare deformation at equal reservoir level but different temperature to test the initial-state model. Retain a separate closure-temperature record for every grouted block group.
units.failure: 把所有壩段視為同時同溫度閉合會忽略施工分期，局部灌漿不完整也可能保留柔弱面。若模型沒有記錄封拱狀態，溫度應力的符號可能被錯判。~Assuming simultaneous equal-temperature closure misses construction staging, and incomplete grouting leaves compliant interfaces. Without the closure state, even the sign of inferred thermal stress can be misinterpreted.
units.misconception: 接縫灌漿溫度只影響施工方便，不影響後續拱壩受力。~Joint-grouting temperature affects convenience only and not later arch-dam structural behavior.
units.practice: 以封拱溫度與接縫閉合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對灌漿時的多點溫度而非單一氣溫，將接縫計零點與施工日期連結；比較後續同庫位不同溫度的變形，確認模型初始狀態可重現觀測。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for closure temperature and joint closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check multi-point grouting temperatures rather than ambient air alone and link joint-meter zeros to construction dates. Compare deformation at equal reservoir level but different temperature to test the initial-state model.

units.anchor: 網格收斂與局部奇異~Mesh convergence and singularity
units.title: 網格收斂與局部奇異~Mesh convergence and singularity
units.mechanism: 三維分析須區分真正的應力集中和幾何尖角造成的數值奇異。網格愈細不一定讓尖角最大應力收斂，應同時檢查位移、能量與有限區域平均。 假設兩次細化壩頂位移由12.0降至11.7 mm，相對差0.3/11.7=2.564%；此差只衡量該位移，不能保證局部應力已收斂。 只報最細網格最大應力可能讓數值奇異冒充材料失效，反之只看位移收斂也會漏掉接觸邊緣問題。收斂是特定輸出量的性質，不能概括全部結果。~Three-dimensional analysis must distinguish physical concentration from numerical singularities at sharp corners. Finer meshes may not converge the point maximum, requiring displacement, energy and finite-area averages to be checked together. Assume refined crest displacement changes from 12.0 to 11.7 mm. Relative difference is 2.564 percent, describing this displacement only rather than proving local stress convergence. Reporting only the finest-mesh maximum can mistake a singularity for material failure, while displacement convergence can miss contact-edge issues. Convergence applies to a specific output and cannot certify every model result.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩次細化壩頂位移由12.0降至11.7 mm，相對差0.3/11.7=2.564%；此差只衡量該位移，不能保證局部應力已收斂。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume refined crest displacement changes from 12.0 to 11.7 mm. Relative difference is 2.564 percent, describing this displacement only rather than proving local stress convergence.
units.verify: 保持材料與荷載不變細化網格，分別追蹤位移、反力和局部平均應力；檢查尖角最大值是否隨單元尺寸無界增加，並以合理幾何圓角測試模型敏感性。對有限面積平均應力另做網格收斂曲線。~Refine meshes with unchanged materials and loads, tracking displacement, reactions and local average stress separately. Check whether corner maxima grow without bound and test sensitivity to physically reasonable geometric rounding. Construct a separate mesh-convergence curve for stress averaged over finite areas.
units.failure: 只報最細網格最大應力可能讓數值奇異冒充材料失效，反之只看位移收斂也會漏掉接觸邊緣問題。收斂是特定輸出量的性質，不能概括全部結果。~Reporting only the finest-mesh maximum can mistake a singularity for material failure, while displacement convergence can miss contact-edge issues. Convergence applies to a specific output and cannot certify every model result.
units.misconception: 壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。~Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress.
units.practice: 以網格收斂與局部奇異編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。保持材料與荷載不變細化網格，分別追蹤位移、反力和局部平均應力；檢查尖角最大值是否隨單元尺寸無界增加，並以合理幾何圓角測試模型敏感性。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for mesh convergence and singularity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Refine meshes with unchanged materials and loads, tracking displacement, reactions and local average stress separately. Check whether corner maxima grow without bound and test sensitivity to physically reasonable geometric rounding.

units.anchor: 地震慣性與附加水質量~Seismic inertia and added water mass
units.title: 地震慣性與附加水質量~Seismic inertia and added water mass
units.mechanism: 地震作用同時包含壩體、基礎和庫水的動力互制，靜力慣性項只提供量級。附加水質量隨頻率與邊界改變，不能任意當成固定壩重增加。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設等效振動質量5 million kg、水平加速度0.1g，慣性力ma=4.905 MN；僅單模態量級，不含動力放大或真實庫水附加質量。 把峰值地面加速度直接乘全部壩重不能代表每點同相加速，基礎柔度與輻射阻尼也會改變反應。忽略水庫耦合可能錯估頻率和壩頂放大。~Earthquake response involves dam, foundation and reservoir interaction. A static inertia term gives only a scale, while hydrodynamic added mass depends on frequency and boundaries rather than an arbitrary fixed weight increase. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume equivalent vibrating mass 5 million kg and horizontal acceleration 0.1g. Inertia ma=4.905 MN, a single-mode scale without dynamic amplification or actual reservoir added mass. Peak ground acceleration times total weight does not mean every point accelerates in phase. Foundation compliance, radiation damping and reservoir coupling can change frequencies and crest amplification substantially.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設等效振動質量5 million kg、水平加速度0.1g，慣性力ma=4.905 MN；僅單模態量級，不含動力放大或真實庫水附加質量。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume equivalent vibrating mass 5 million kg and horizontal acceleration 0.1g. Inertia ma=4.905 MN, a single-mode scale without dynamic amplification or actual reservoir added mass.
units.verify: 以觀測或辨識的模態檢查頻率與阻尼，核對輸入地震在基礎和自由場的定義；比較含水與無水模型的反應，保留頻率相關邊界而非只調總質量。以能量平衡檢查附加水質量模型的合理性。~Check identified frequencies and damping and distinguish foundation input from free-field motion. Compare models with and without water, retaining frequency-dependent boundaries rather than adjusting total mass alone. Use an energy balance to check the plausibility of added-water-mass modeling.
units.failure: 把峰值地面加速度直接乘全部壩重不能代表每點同相加速，基礎柔度與輻射阻尼也會改變反應。忽略水庫耦合可能錯估頻率和壩頂放大。~Peak ground acceleration times total weight does not mean every point accelerates in phase. Foundation compliance, radiation damping and reservoir coupling can change frequencies and crest amplification substantially.
units.misconception: 把峰值地面加速度乘壩重就能完整代表三維地震反應。~Peak ground acceleration times dam weight completely represents three-dimensional earthquake response.
units.practice: 以地震慣性與附加水質量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以觀測或辨識的模態檢查頻率與阻尼，核對輸入地震在基礎和自由場的定義；比較含水與無水模型的反應，保留頻率相關邊界而非只調總質量。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for seismic inertia and added water mass, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check identified frequencies and damping and distinguish foundation input from free-field motion. Compare models with and without water, retaining frequency-dependent boundaries rather than adjusting total mass alone.

units.anchor: 水溫荷載與監測殘差~Hydrothermal effects and monitoring residuals
units.title: 水溫荷載與監測殘差~Hydrothermal effects and monitoring residuals
units.mechanism: 拱壩位移同時受庫水位、溫度和時間影響，異常診斷需先扣除可解釋的正常反應。統計模型只能在已驗證範圍內描述資料，不直接證明結構安全。 線性係數分別為0.1 mm/m與0.2 mm/K。假設教學位移模型d=0.1ΔH+0.2ΔT mm，ΔH=10 m、ΔT=5 K，預測2 mm；觀測2.6 mm則殘差0.6 mm，非警戒值。 高度相關的水位與溫度會讓係數難以識別，模型也可能把長期損傷吸收為時間趨勢。重新訓練前若未檢查原因，異常可能被數學上消除卻仍存在。~Arch displacement responds to water level, temperature and time, so anomaly interpretation first removes explainable normal behavior. Statistical models describe validated data ranges rather than independently proving structural safety. The linear coefficients are 0.1 mm/m and 0.2 mm/K, respectively. Assume teaching displacement d=0.1ΔH+0.2ΔT mm with ΔH=10 m and ΔT=5 K. Prediction is 2 mm; observation 2.6 mm leaves residual 0.6 mm, not an alarm threshold. Correlated level and temperature make coefficients difficult to identify, and a time trend can absorb deterioration. Retraining without investigating causes may mathematically erase an anomaly while its physical source remains.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：線性係數分別為0.1 mm/m與0.2 mm/K。假設教學位移模型d=0.1ΔH+0.2ΔT mm，ΔH=10 m、ΔT=5 K，預測2 mm；觀測2.6 mm則殘差0.6 mm，非警戒值。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The linear coefficients are 0.1 mm/m and 0.2 mm/K, respectively. Assume teaching displacement d=0.1ΔH+0.2ΔT mm with ΔH=10 m and ΔT=5 K. Prediction is 2 mm; observation 2.6 mm leaves residual 0.6 mm, not an alarm threshold.
units.verify: 用獨立時段驗證模型並檢查殘差隨季節和水位的結構，核對儀器更換與基準漂移；將局部裂縫、滲流與位移證據交叉比較，避免單靠統計超限下結論。將儀器更換前後的殘差分布分開檢查。~Validate on an independent period and examine residual patterns with season and level, checking instrument changes and datum drift. Cross-check cracks, seepage and movement instead of drawing conclusions from a statistical exceedance alone. Check residual distributions before and after instrument replacement as separate periods.
units.failure: 高度相關的水位與溫度會讓係數難以識別，模型也可能把長期損傷吸收為時間趨勢。重新訓練前若未檢查原因，異常可能被數學上消除卻仍存在。~Correlated level and temperature make coefficients difficult to identify, and a time trend can absorb deterioration. Retraining without investigating causes may mathematically erase an anomaly while its physical source remains.
units.misconception: 只要重新擬合後殘差變小，就證明原先結構異常已消失。~A smaller residual after refitting proves the original structural anomaly has disappeared.
units.practice: 以水溫荷載與監測殘差編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用獨立時段驗證模型並檢查殘差隨季節和水位的結構，核對儀器更換與基準漂移；將局部裂縫、滲流與位移證據交叉比較，避免單靠統計超限下結論。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydrothermal effects and monitoring residuals, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Validate on an independent period and examine residual patterns with season and level, checking instrument changes and datum drift. Cross-check cracks, seepage and movement instead of drawing conclusions from a statistical exceedance alone.

facts: 教學薄圓拱膜壓應力5 MPa，未含彎曲。~Teaching thin circular-arch membrane compression is 5 MPa, excluding bending.
教學平行剛度分擔得到共同位移2 mm。~Teaching parallel stiffness sharing gives common displacement 2 mm.
教學20 MN推力法向分量17.3205 MN。~Teaching thrust 20 MN has normal component 17.3205 MN.
教學單面無黏聚滑動抗力比1.5405。~The teaching cohesionless single-plane resistance ratio is 1.5405.
教學裂隙三角壓力合力40 MN。~Teaching triangular joint-pressure resultant is 40 MN.
教學封拱後自由降溫收縮16 mm，非實際開縫量。~Teaching free cooling contraction is 16 mm, not actual joint opening.
